newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy '97 debt servicing bill 184 trln lire - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italy '97 debt servicing bill 184 trln lire - Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday that Italy's debt servicing costs would be 184 trillion lire ($110.8 billion) this year.
Ciampi told a news conference the interest bill was based on the yield of 12-month bills, BOTs, at the last auction last year of 6.52 percent.
"We're not discounting any further fall (in yields). We are discounting a stabilisation at this level," Ciampi said.
The government's official three-year economic plan, published last year, forecast that debt servicing costs would total 192.4 trillion lire in 1997.
State economic research institute Isco said in a recent report that debt servicing costs were 194 trillion lire in 1996.
